entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Matiur Rehman Khan
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Shri O.P. Singh, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Shri Arun Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioner; Mrs. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and Shri Pradeep Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the informant.
2. The present writ petition is preferred with following reliefs:-
"i. issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari to quash the impugned first information report dated 08.02.2024 in Case Crime No. 0040 of 2024 under Sections 363, 342, 376, 506 IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Lar,
Aman Singh vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44275736/
1 District Deoria lodged by respondent No. 4 against the petitioners.
ii. Issue a writ or order direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent nos. 2 and 3 not to arrest or harass the petitioner in pursuance to the impugned F.I.R. dated 08.02.2024 in Case Crime No. 0040 of 2024 under Sections 363, 342,
376, 506 IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Lar, District Deoria lodged by respondent No. 4 against the petitioner.
iii. Issue or pass any other appropriate order or direction which this Hon'ble court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
iv. Award the cost of the writ petition in favour of the petitioner."
3. In response to the order dated 12.03.2024 passed by this Court, Shri Kapil Dev Chaudhary,
Station House Officer, P.S. Lar, District Deoria is present in the Court alongwith the entire record of investigation including the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
4.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, once we declined to quash the impugned first information report, Shri O.P. Singh, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Shri Arun Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioner fairly states that the present writ petition may be dismissed as not pressed and leave may be accorded to avail other remedy as available under law.
5. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed.
The presence of Shri Kapil Dev Chaudhary, Station House Officer, P.S. Lar, District Deoria is dispensed with.

Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Jaswant  Aman Singh vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44275736/
